movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands joined in the beginning; man may raise hands during seguidilla
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular; man moves outside the circle in Punto de Mejorana
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumping in some variants like Punto Santeño
movement_profile.posture: Upright, with expressions of longing and passion

signature_moves.description: The male and female walk around in a wide circle.
signature_moves.name: El Paseo

signature_moves.description: Dancers face each other and show off skill and dexterity.
signature_moves.name: El Zapateo

music_profile.sound_description: A rustic, melodic fiddle or accordion leads over a ternary-subdivided rhythmic base provided by folk drums and chordophones.

basic_steps: Kneeling start with left knee on floor
Walking in a wide circle (El Paseo)
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination and grace; specific steps repeat two or three times.
